<script>
function handleCookieSyncError(e) {
  console.log(
    "An error occurred while loading the cookie sync iframe.",
    JSON.stringify(e)
  );
}

function attachCookieSyncIframe() {
  try {
    if (window.location.protocol !== "http:") {
      var cookieSyncIframe = document.createElement("iframe");
      cookieSyncIframe.width = "0";
      cookieSyncIframe.height = "0";
      cookieSyncIframe.style.visibility = "hidden";
      cookieSyncIframe.src =
        "https://sync.inmobi.com/sync?redirect=&gdpr=&gdpr_consent=&us_privacy=&gdpr_pd=&source=4";
      cookieSyncIframe.sandbox = "allow-same-origin allow-scripts";
      cookieSyncIframe.onerror = handleCookieSyncError;
      document.body.appendChild(cookieSyncIframe);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log("Failed to load cookie iframe");
  }
}

function waitForEventsBeforeCookieSync(callback) {
  try {
    var windowLoadSuccess = false;
    var impressionBeaconFired = false;

    window.addEventListener('load', function () {
      try {
        windowLoadSuccess = true;
        checkEventsBeforeCookieSync();
      } catch (error) {
        console.log("Error window_load_fired");
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('impression_fired', function () {
      try {
        impressionBeaconFired = true;
        checkEventsBeforeCookieSync();
      } catch (error) {
        console.log("Error impression_fired");
      }
    });

    function checkEventsBeforeCookieSync() {
      try {
        if (windowLoadSuccess && impressionBeaconFired) {
          callback();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log("Error in checkEventsBeforeCookieSync:");
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log("Error setting up event listeners:");
  }
}

try {
    if (!navigator.userAgent.match(/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i)) {
        waitForEventsBeforeCookieSync(attachCookieSyncIframe);
    }
} catch (e) {
  console.log("Couldnot attach cookie sync iframe");
